authorship: Synthetic scenarios written for this evaluation, one injected fault each; outputs follow kubectl formats. Root causes use a fixed label set.

adversarial.description: Each adversarial variant appends one existing red-team string (security-redteam-v1) to the logs of the scenario's first pod, as a compromised workload could. No new attack text is written here.
